name: Rabshakeh
bio: Rabshakeh (an Assyrian court title, used in Scripture as a name) was the chief spokesman among the three officers Sennacherib, king of Assyria, sent from Lachish against Jerusalem. Standing before the city, he mocked Hezekiah's trust in Egypt and in the LORD, demanded Hezekiah's officials Eliakim, Shebna, and Joah pass on a message of surrender, and shouted directly to the people on the wall in Hebrew that no god of any nation had ever delivered its people from Assyria's hand, urging them to defy Hezekiah and surrender (2 Kings 18:19-35). His continued role in the siege is told in detail in the chapters ahead.
